bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
cd "$root"
test -d .git || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 62
git fetch --no-tags origin chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
new=1c7d6a7888b3cd118e5f522d3337f1acb50d509a
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$new" || exit 64
file=scripts/userbot_link_video_caption_smoke.py
saved=scripts/userbot_link_saved_message_smoke.py
ipc=scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py
test ! -e "$file" && test ! -L "$file" || exit 65
test -f "$saved" && test ! -L "$saved" || exit 66
test "$(git hash-object "$saved")" = "$(git rev-parse 2a14860de125d9ddb944e2138a69fde14b917c9c:$saved)" || exit 67
test -f "$ipc" && test ! -L "$ipc" || exit 68
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-link-video-check.XXXXXXXX)"
cp "$saved" "$tmp/saved_old.py"
cp "$ipc" "$tmp/ipc_old.py"
git show "$new:$file" >"$tmp/video_new.py" || exit 69
git show "$new:$saved" >"$tmp/saved_new.py" || exit 70
git show "$new:scripts/userbot_test_client.py" >"$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" || exit 71
python3 - "$tmp" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
base=Path(sys.argv[1])
s=(base/"ipc_old.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if "link_video_caption_smoke" in s:raise SystemExit(72)
mark="ACTIONS = frozenset("
if mark not in s:raise SystemExit(73)
begin=s.index(mark)
end=s.index("\n",begin)
pos=s.find('"link_photo_caption_smoke"',begin,end)
if pos<0:raise SystemExit(74)
s=s[:pos]+'"link_video_caption_smoke", '+s[pos:]
needle='    if action == "link_photo_caption_smoke":'
if s.count(needle)!=1:raise SystemExit(75)
newbranch='    if action == "link_video_caption_smoke":\n        from userbot_link_video_caption_smoke import run\n        return {"request_id":request_id,**await run(client)}\n'
s=s.replace(needle,newbranch+needle,1)
(base/"ipc_new.py").write_text(s,encoding="utf-8")
for p in ("ipc_new.py","video_new.py","saved_new.py","userbot_test_client.py"):
 compile((base/p).read_bytes(),str(base/p),"exec")
PY
swapped=0
ok=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$ok" != 1; then
  cp "$tmp/saved_old.py" "$saved" || true
  cp "$tmp/ipc_old.py" "$ipc" || true
  rm -f "$file"
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
cp "$tmp/video_new.py" "$file"
cp "$tmp/saved_new.py" "$saved"
cp "$tmp/ipc_new.py" "$ipc"
swapped=1
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 76
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$tmp/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=1;break;fi
 sleep 2
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 77
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 78
ok=1
echo LINK_VIDEO_TEST_ROUTE=PASS
echo USERBOT_EXISTING_SESSION=PASS
